lines.text: Two points on a number line: zero and sixty-four.
lines.caption: Two points on a number line: zero and sixty-four.

lines.text: Each new point is halfway between the last two. Where does the tenth land?
lines.caption: Each new point is halfway between the last two. Where does the tenth land?

lines.text: The first point is zero, the second is sixty-four.
lines.caption: The first point is zero, the second is sixty-four.

lines.text: Each later point is the midpoint of the last two. Where is the tenth?
lines.caption: Each later point is the midpoint of the last two. Where is the tenth?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Watch the jumps: sixty-four right, thirty-two left, sixteen right.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Watch the jumps: sixty-four right, thirty-two left, sixteen right.

lines.text: Each jump is half the last one, and it flips direction!
lines.caption: Each jump is half the last one, and it flips direction!

lines.text: Then eight left, four right, two left, one right, a half left, a quarter right.
lines.caption: Then eight left, four right, two left, one right, a half left, a quarter right.

lines.text: Closer and closer, the tenth point lands at forty-two and three quarters!
lines.caption: Closer and closer, the tenth point lands at forty-two and three quarters!

lines.text: Want to see why? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Want to see why? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
